<th class="th" colspan="1">3 Months Ended</th>
</tr>
<tr><th class="th"><div>Sep. 30, 2026</div></th></tr>
<tr class="re">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsSharebasedPaymentsAbstract', window );"><strong>Share-Based Payment Arrangement [Abstract]</strong></a></td>
<td class="text">&#160;<span></span>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="ro">
<td class="pl" style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_DisclosureOfCompensationRelatedCostsShareBasedPaymentsTextBlock', window );">Share-based Compensation</a></td>
<td class="text">Share-based Compensation<div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Prior to the Rangers Distribution, certain employees of the Company participated in the MSG Knicks 2015 Employee Stock Plan (as amended, the &#8220;MSG Knicks Employee Stock Plan&#8221;) and directors of MSG Knicks participated in the 2015 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors (as amended, the &#8220;MSG Knicks Non-Employee Director Plan&#8221;). </span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Effective as of immediately prior (but subject to) the Rangers Distribution, the Company adopted two share-based compensation plans: the 2026 Employee Stock Plan (the &#8220;Employee Stock Plan&#8221;) and the 2026 Stock Plan for Non-Employee Directors (the &#8220;Non-Employee Director Plan&#8221;). Under the Employee Stock Plan, the Company is authorized to grant incentive stock options, non-qualified stock options, stock appreciation rights, restricted shares, restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;), and other equity-based awards. The Company may grant awards under the Employee Stock Plan for up to an aggregate number of 1,000 shares of Class A Common stock, which may be either treasury shares or authorized but unissued shares. The terms and conditions of awards granted under the Employee Stock Plan, including vesting and exercisability, are determined by the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of the Company (&#8220;Compensation Committee&#8221;) and may include terms or conditions based upon performance criteria. Under the Non-Employee Director Plan, the Company is authorized to grant non-qualified stock options, RSUs, and other equity-based awards. The Company may grant awards under this plan for up to an aggregate number of 250 shares of Class A Common Stock, which may be either treasury shares or authorized but unissued shares. The terms and conditions of awards granted under the Non-Employee Director Plan, including vesting and exercisability, are determined by the Compensation Committee.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Share-based compensation expense recognized in the accompanying combined statements of operations and comprehensive loss includes expense specifically attributed to the Company&#8217;s direct employees as well as an allocation from MSG Knicks of share-based compensation expense related to certain employees of MSG Knicks, including directors, corporate executives, and corporate staff. Share-based compensation expense related to MSG Knicks employees has been allocated on a pro-rata basis of combined revenue, which management has deemed to be reasonable.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Share-based compensation expense is recognized in the accompanying combined statements of operations and comprehensive loss as a component of Selling, general and administrative expenses. Share-based compensation expense recorded during the </span><span style="background-color:#ffffff;color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">three months ended September&#160;30, 2026 and </span><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">2025 was $1,500 and $1,800, respectively, of which $1,425 and $1,722 related to directors and employees of MSG Knicks, respectively, and $75 and $78 related to compensation expenses for direct employees of the Company, respectively.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">Restricted Stock Units Award Activity</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">The following table summarizes activity related to MSG Knicks&#8217; restricted stock units (&#8220;RSUs&#8221;) and performance stock units (&#8220;PSUs&#8221;), held by the Company&#8217;s direct employees, for the three months ended September&#160;30, 2026:</span></div><div $196.02.</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;line-height:120%">Treatment After the Rangers Distribution of Outstanding Awards Initially Granted Under MSG Knicks Stock Plans</span></div><div style="margin-top:6pt"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10pt;font-weight:400;line-height:120%">In connection with the Rangers Distribution, (i) each holder of a MSG Knicks employee RSU or performance stock unit (&#8220;PSU&#8221;) received one Company RSU or PSU, as applicable, issued under the Employee Stock Plan in respect of every two MSG Knicks RSUs or PSUs owned on the Record Date and continues to be entitled to one share of MSG Knicks&#8217; Class A common stock (or at the option of the compensation committee, cash or other property) for each MSG Knicks RSU or PSU in accordance with the applicable MSG Knicks award agreement, (ii) each holder of a MSG Knicks non-employee director RSU received one share of Class A Common Stock issued under the Non-Employee Director Plan in respect of every two MSG Knicks RSUs owned on the Record Date and continues to be entitled to one share of MSG Knicks&#8217; Class A common stock (or at the option of the compensation committee, cash or other property) in accordance with the applicable MSG Knicks award agreement, and (iii) for each option to purchase MSG Knicks&#8217; Class A common stock owned on the Record Date, one option to purchase Class A Common Stock was issued under the Employee Stock Plan.</span></div><span></span>
